related.title: WebAssembly：線性記憶體與界限 trap
related.titleEn: WebAssembly: linear memory and bounds traps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付relocation.csv與十六進位／十進位雙欄；此教學不修改執行檔或繞過ASLR。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver relocation.csv in hex and decimal; the exercise neither patches binaries nor bypasses ASLR. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 用半開區間[offset,offset+width)測邊界，區分記憶體增長與普通store；記錄little-endian解碼。
related.differenceEn: Test half-open[offset,offset+width), distinguish memory growth from store and record little-endian decoding.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
重定位把符號與載入位置合成位址；ASLR改變base而非每個相對offset。不同relocation種類有不同公式。
本課數值核對：4096+288 = 4384 address；另一項核對：32768+288 = 33056 address。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

線性記憶體有明確位元組界限；load/store需整段在範圍內，越界會trap而非自動延伸。
本課數值核對：65532+4 = 65536 end_address；另一項核對：65533+4-65536 = 1 overflow_B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Relocations combine symbols with load positions; ASLR changes the base rather than every relative offset. Different relocation types use different formulas.
Numeric audit: 4096+288 = 4384 address; second audit: 32768+288 = 33056 address. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Linear memory has explicit byte bounds; an entire load/store must lie inside, and out-of-bounds access traps rather than extending memory.
Numeric audit: 65532+4 = 65536 end_address; second audit: 65533+4-65536 = 1 overflow_B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Bellman–Ford：負權與負循環證據
related.titleEn: Bellman–Ford: negative weights and negative-cycle evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付relocation.csv與十六進位／十進位雙欄；此教學不修改執行檔或繞過ASLR。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver relocation.csv in hex and decimal; the exercise neither patches binaries nor bypasses ASLR. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 用四節點做三輪relax，保存每輪距離；第四輪若仍改善則追predecessor尋找循環。
related.differenceEn: For four vertices perform three relaxation rounds, retaining distances; an improvement on round4 triggers predecessor-based cycle extraction.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
重定位把符號與載入位置合成位址；ASLR改變base而非每個相對offset。不同relocation種類有不同公式。
本課數值核對：4096+288 = 4384 address；另一項核對：32768+288 = 33056 address。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

反覆relax可處理負邊；若可從source到達的負循環存在，就不能給受影響節點有限最短路徑。
本課數值核對：4-2+3 = 5 cost；另一項核對：-2+1 = -1 cost。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Relocations combine symbols with load positions; ASLR changes the base rather than every relative offset. Different relocation types use different formulas.
Numeric audit: 4096+288 = 4384 address; second audit: 32768+288 = 33056 address. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Repeated relaxation handles negative edges; a reachable negative cycle prevents finite shortest paths for affected vertices.
Numeric audit: 4-2+3 = 5 cost; second audit: -2+1 = -1 cost. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
